title: kapelle run file
description: An authoring aid, not a validator. core/runfile.ts's validateRun is the only check that runs: a schema cannot fill defaults, reach the agent registry for the maxMode ceiling, spot a duplicate task id, or say "task dependencies land in M3". One test asserts these property names equal RUN_KEYS and TASK_KEYS, so this file cannot drift away from the validator unnoticed.

maxConcurrency.description: Most harness subprocesses alive at once.

note.description: What a JSON comment would have said.

agent.description: Run-level default. A task's own agent wins.

allowReadOutsideRoot.description: Forced to false under safe, however it was asked for.

cmd.description: A custom harness command, e.g. "node mock-agent.mjs". Wins over agent, and warns as unverified — it has no measured half.

worktree.description: A base ref to branch from. Never a path, and never another task's name: worktree inheritance lands in M3.

stallIdleMs.description: Warn when a task sends nothing for this many ms. The task keeps running. 0 disables.

stallRepeatCount.description: Warn when the same tool title fires this many times in a row — the busy loop idle time cannot see. The task keeps running. 0 disables.

ttlMs.description: Wall time for one task. On expiry the client sends session/cancel, marks the task timed_out and keeps its branch. 0 disables.

mode.description: safe = reads only; ask = mutations prompt (needs a TTY, else it resolves as safe); auto = approve everything. A mode above the agent's ceiling is rejected, never downgraded.

id.description: Names a git branch, so it is validated and never sanitised. Unique within the run.

needs.description: Task dependencies land in M3. M1 rejects a non-empty needs rather than running the tasks in parallel and returning a plausible wrong answer.
